description: This file contains utility functions for converting model parameters to and from a single vector representation, including device consistency checks.

methods.name: parameters_to_vector
methods.description: Flattens an iterable of model parameters into a single vector.

methods.name: vector_to_parameters
methods.description: Copies slices of a vector into model parameters, updating their data.

methods.name: _check_param_device
methods.description: Checks if parameters are on the same device, raises error if not.
